intent: pre-commit's pytest hook stops failing with a collection ImportError when meta/requirements-test.txt gains a pin the hook's interpreter lacks (fastmcp from a4738c6f), and main's CI pre-commit job goes green again.
scope: meta/scripts/pytest_changed_packages.py: install absent test pins before running pytest
Non-goal: upgrading present packages at other versions; only absent ones are installed
changes: pytest_changed_packages.py lists requirements-test.txt pins whose distribution is not installed (pip comment rule keeps #subdirectory URL fragments) and pip-installs them into the running interpreter (--user --break-system-packages outside a venv) before pytest; a failed install fails the hook
Bumped the two pins the dependency-freshness gate reports behind latest stable (the cause of main's red Pre-commit checks run 43829221139)
